classes.whole_policy: Root-to-terminal outcome of a fixed policy on all 330 CONFIRM tasks; equal task weight over the planned repeated executions (2 live runs per task per policy).
classes.initial_action_logger_continued: Root-to-terminal contrast of the two initial actions, each followed by the randomized logger; all 330 CONFIRM tasks, equal task weight. NOT a whole-policy contrast. Worker label: none of the four named classes fits; the lead may reclassify.
classes.pooled_repair: Contrast at a repair decision among histories the logger reached, pooled over episodes or prefixes; weights are realized eligible counts, not tasks.
classes.realized_frame: Conditional on the realized 564-prefix frame F and the realized log. SECONDARY target.
classes.selected_cohort: Restricted to tasks selected on realized action support or realized denominators; changes cohort and weights. Exploratory only.
classes.descriptive: Counts or occupancy of realized records; no contrast target. Worker label, as above.
